name: The Dreaming City Chronicles: Quest for the Vanished World
source:
This breathtaking journey will transport you to a world where reality and dreams entwine, where the essence of your being will be shaped by the choices you make. Join us on this ethereal odyssey as we unveil the perplexing disappearance of Aoi, a quest that leads to unforeseen and disquieting secrets concealed within the souls of the town's denizens. Prepare yourself, dear adventurer, for sometimes ignorance may be a safer refuge than the unsettling truths that lurk in the shadows. Ha-ha, indeed.
Get ready for an epic adventure with twists and turns that will keep you on the edge of your seat. With multiple endings to uncover, the fate of The Dreaming Cite is in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and unlock the ultimate finale?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这段激动人心的旅程将带你进入一个现实与梦想交织在一起的世界，在那里你的存在的本质将由你所做的选择塑造。与我们一起踏上这段空灵的冒险之旅，揭开葵令人费解的失踪事件，这一任务将导致镇上居民灵魂中隐藏的不可预见且令人不安的秘密。亲爱的冒险家，请做好准备，因为有时无知可能比潜伏在阴影中的令人不安的真相更安全。哈哈，确实如此。
准备好迎接一场曲折的史诗冒险，让你坐立不安。有多个结局等待揭开，梦想之城的命运掌握在你的手中。你会迎接挑战并解锁最终结局吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405800/]Steam[/url]]
